inj.note: Shavers remains on the reserve/PUP list with a knee injury despite logging three consecutive full practices during Week 9 prep. The wide receiver could return to the active roster ahead of Monday night's showdown with the Vikings, but it will be contingent on the Bills creating a spot on the 53-man roster in time.
